subject: Next steps — Product peek timebox & stakeholder pairing
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Monroe <alex.monroe@heliosoft.com>, Jordan Li <jordan.li@heliosoft.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Next steps — Product peek timebox & stakeholder pairing

Hi Alex / Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery:

- We confirmed HelioSoft’s priority is reducing inference cost for batch scoring and having a predictable latency tail for interactive features.
- Success criteria: <20% token-cost reduction without quality loss, 99th pct latency target for API requests.
- Key stakeholders to include on the demo: Platform owner (Jordan), one ML/infra engineer, and a product manager.

Would you two be available for a 30-minute product peek next week? I suggest two tight timebands to keep the session focused:

Option A: Tue Jul 13, 09:30–10:00 PT
Option B: Wed Jul 14, 13:00–13:30 PT

If neither works, drop 2–3 windows that fit Jordan and your ML lead and we’ll adapt. Agenda (attached):
- 5m recap of goals + scope
- 15m live demo with cost/latency examples and routing options
- 10m Q&A + next steps/mutual action plan

Attachments: post-discovery-notes.pdf (short notes from today), proposed-30min-agenda.docx

Priyom — looping you in to help with logistics and to cover pricing/committing options if the demo lands well.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2026 02:04:22 +0000
Subject: Re: Next steps — Product peek timebox & stakeholder pairing

Irene — thanks for the recap and the clear agenda. Both Jordan and I reviewed calendars; quick answers below:

- Jordan can do Option A (Tue Jul 13, 09:30 PT).
- I’m out of office on Jul 14 but can make Jul 15, 10:00–10:30 PT if that’s easier.

Jordan, can you confirm if your ML/infra lead (we’ll invite Sam Park) can join Option A? If Sam can’t, we can do Jul 15 and have our infra team on the second call.

Also — would appreciate a quick note in the calendar invite about any sample data or hostnames required for the demo so Sam can pull logs if needed.

Thanks,
Alex
Sr. Product Manager | HelioSoft
alex.monroe@heliosoft.com

Thanks Alex — sounds good.

Jordan / Sam — would you prefer the Tue Jul 13 slot (09:30 PT) to get the ML/infra owner on the first touch, or should we move to Jul 15 (10:00 PT) so Alex + Sam can both attend? We’re happy to run the first session as a product-focused 30m and schedule a second follow-up deep dive for infra if needed.

A few prep notes for whoever will join as the ML/infra engineer:
- If you want us to run live workload samples, please have a small sample of your scoring payload (JSON, ~20 records) available.
- We’ll share a short runbook in the invite that lists any ports/hostnames needed for demo data pulls (no production creds).

I’ll hold Option A on my calendar for now and will send a calendar invite once we confirm the attendee list. Priyom will include high-level pricing/commitment options in the invite description.

Links: scheduling (https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-product-peek), deal record (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/RD-2026-HELI-379), prep doc (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cPrepDoc)

Best,
Irene
